candidate_workaround: Classify the preview as scanner output, run a complete pre-promotion scan, add recovery evidence, and run a second post-promotion scan before freeze.
failure_signature: The final scan treated two privacy class labels in its own preview receipt as payload, while an earlier witness had already described the final scan as passed.
recurrence_guard: Quarantine scanner-output receipts explicitly and never describe a later scan as passed before it executes.
rollback: Keep x1 uncommitted, retain the recursive candidates and premature witness, and require a post-promotion scan.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-scoped scanner-output recovery only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.
title: Break scanner-output recursion with post-promotion coverage
trigger_preconditions: A scanner receipt is itself included in the surface and Method Flow evidence is generated from its result.
